acceptance: Each listed site calls internal/gotestname; grep finds no other copy of the two rules under go/.
A red-first test shows Testify is not a test name at each of the 6 test-name sites.
The package notes of the changed packages name the change; 100% statement coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: Replace each copy with a call to the internal/gotestname helpers. For a drifted copy, first pin its current walk with a test; where the migration widens the skipped set (vendor, '.', '_'), state the change in the package note. ciparity and acsnames change behaviour, so give them a red-first test each.
source: console 2026-11-03: PR #1255 (cloud/vacuous-test-guard) made internal/gotestname the one home of the ignored-directory rule (IgnoredDir) and the test-name rule; its fix comment lists the copies it left
summary: The ignored-directory rule has 2 identical copies (coversplit/detect.go:74, sizeratchet/sizeratchet.go:55) and 10 drifted copies (rawgitratchet:61, coverstrict:205, codeshape/tree.go:155, codeshape/funcs.go:44, commentaudit/stats.go:46, triagecap/floors.go:260, test/structure/sources.go:21, cmd/evolve/cmd_docs.go:200, ciparity/e2e_run.go:32, acs/regression/acsnames/names.go:130). The test-name rule has 6 plain strings.HasPrefix(name, "Test") copies that accept Testify (acssuite/inventory.go:74, acssuite/scopelint.go:72, handoff/request/request.go:125, paralleltest/paralleltest.go:181, evalgate/floorbinding.go:101, acspathscan/scan.go:51). Each copy can drift from the rule that the guards and the floor use.
title: Migrate the remaining copies of the Go ignored-directory and test-name rules to their one home
